title: Each open PR carries its state on GitHub, and a sweep names the ones without
why: Owner ask, 12:17 CST Nov 7: "How many PRs are sitting idle that haven't merged because you lost track ... mechanize this better, this is an obvious gap." Measured by the coordinator at 12:24 CST: 36 open claude-settings PRs and 16 q_max PRs are named in neither its handoff nor runner 8's queue; #1371 (git mailbox, round 3 PASS Nov 6) is one.
note: Each open PR carries a state label on GitHub (queue, held, parked, replaced), not in a session's handoff. A sweep at each coordinator and batch-runner wake lists open PRs with no state label, or a state older than its limit, and names them in the report. Done check: the sweep goes red on an unlabelled open PR and green when every one has a state.
